verdict.rationale: Carta documents official Claude MCP plugins that let users query cap table data (ownership, SAFEs, grants, 409A valuations) and investor/fund data with natural language. The Investors plugin can also generate tear sheets, budgets, financial statements and PDFs. Support is mostly read/query and reporting through an external LLM client, with no documented natural-language control of write operations or a native in-product command interface. Missing for 10: natural-language execution of state-changing actions (e.g., issuing grants, editing cap tables), a native in-app natural-language interface, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Access ownership, stakeholder lists, SAFEs, convertible notes, option grants, 409A valuations, financing history, compensation benchmarks, and more — all with natural language questions.

Access NAV, fund performance, partner data, journal entries, portfolio company financials, build Excel budgets and consolidating P&L / balance sheets, and generate professional PDFs for investor reporting — all with natural language.
The Carta Investors plugin gives LLMs access to your fund's data and allows you to generate tear sheets, budgets, and financial statements.
